basic_profile.bio: I am a space simulation enthusiast and a seasoned pilot in Elite Dangerous, specializing in exploration and combat. Based out of Portland, Oregon, I spend my evenings and weekends navigating the cosmos. During the day, I'm a software engineer working on AI algorithms, which fuels my interest in technology and gaming. I'm married to a fellow gamer, and we often team up for co-op missions. My dislikes include toxicity in gaming communities and lack of in-game tutorials for beginners.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in software engineering with a focus on AI, which has deepened my understanding of gaming mechanics and strategy. This expertise has been honed through years of self-teaching and professional experience. I also actively participate in community discussions to stay updated on the latest game patches and strategies.
